<!-- Every other page on this site opens with a sentence that says what the page
     is; this one used to start straight on a bare `## 学部`, so a reader landed
     on a grid of course cards with no frame around it.

     Punctuation follows the lab site's STYLE.md: full-width 「，」 and 「．」,
     not 「、」 and 「。」. This is the first Japanese prose on the site, so it
     sets the convention — keep new Japanese text consistent with it. -->

法政大学 経営システム工学科で担当している科目です．講義ノートを公開している科目は，
科目名から直接開けます．

<!-- The courses were a grid of bordered cards, each carrying up to four chips
     (年・学期・時限・教室). Between the two grids, the period strip and the
     lecture-note cards, the page held fourteen outlined boxes and sixteen
     chips — a lot of ornament for what is really a six-row list of facts, and
     the teal/amber semester chips were the loudest colour on the site.

     The rows below are the `.news-list` / `.cv-list` device instead: the term
     moves into the fixed left label column, because that is what a reader
     groups courses by, and everything else is one muted line of plain text.
     Term order within a section is 春 then 秋.

     The `\` at the end of the first line of each row is load-bearing — a bare
     newline is joined, and the meta line has to be a line of its own. -->

## 講義ノート

<!-- Restored from a comment. Two reasons it earns its place rather than
     duplicating the course list:

     1. The Reinforcement Learning notes are tied to no course, so while this
        section was commented out they were unreachable from the site at all.
     2. It is a different way in. The rows above are indexed by course — you
        use them if you are enrolled. This list is indexed by subject, for
        someone who wants the notes and is not in the class.

     Pills rather than cards: the section is a short row of links, and after
     the course rows above the page does not need a third stack of boxes.

     The .book-item links must stay on consecutive lines with no blank line
     between them: `.book-links p` is the row, and Pandoc only wraps them in
     one <p> if they form a single paragraph. -->

オープンアクセスで公開している講義ノートです．担当科目に対応するものは，
上の一覧からも開けます．

::: {.book-links}
[Operations Research](https://zi-ang-liu.github.io/or-book/){.book-item}
